name: signalwire-react-native-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @signalwire/react && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-native && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-native-ui
scripts.test: npm run test -w @signalwire/react && npm run test -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run test -w @signalwire/react-native && npm run test -w @signalwire/react-native-ui && npm run test -w @signalwire/rn-push-server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-ui && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-native && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-native-ui && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-native-example && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/react-web-example && npm run type-check -w @signalwire/rn-push-server
scripts.bundle-check: npm run bundle-check -w @signalwire/react-native-example && npm run build -w @signalwire/react-web-example
scripts.verify:package: npm run build && cd packages/react-native && npx publint && npx @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack . --exclude-entrypoints app.plugin.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm test && npm run bundle-check

//overrides: Expo SDK 54 expects React 19.1.0. Several Expo and RN packages declare react as an open peer, which npm auto-installs at the newest 19.x and hoists to the root -- leaving a second React beside the workspaces' pinned 19.1.0. Two React copies in one Metro bundle produce invalid-hook-call failures, so pin the whole tree to one version.
